audience: Israeli businesses that issue invoices and track debts in SUMIT

useCases.title: Check what customers owe
useCases.text: Read the debt of one customer, or the debt report of all customers who owe money.

useCases.title: Find an invoice or receipt
useCases.text: List accounting documents by type, number or date, then open one for its customer, items and payments.

useCases.title: Check the next document number
useCases.text: Read the number SUMIT would give the next document of one type. The read reserves no number.

useCases.title: Check catalog items and stock levels
useCases.text: List catalog items with price, cost and SKU, and the stock level of each item.

useCases.title: Look up VAT and exchange rates
useCases.text: Read the VAT rate for a date, or the exchange rate between two currencies on a date.
